en.Esse líquido sobe sozinho pela parede do: This liquid climbs up the wall of its cup by itself... and escapes! And the last fact is the worst.
en.É hélio, a quase menos duzentos e setent: It's helium, at almost minus two hundred seventy-one degrees Celsius. Follow Maia, it gets weirder: it becomes a superfluid, with zero friction.
en.Uma película finíssima sobe pela parede,: A super thin film creeps up the wall, over the rim, and drips down the outside.
en.E nem no zero absoluto ele congela. Só v: And not even at absolute zero does it freeze. It only turns solid if you squeeze it with tons of pressure.
